entities.summary: Urszula Bogumiła Dudziak-Urbaniak is a Polish jazz vocalist. She has worked with Krzysztof Komeda, Michał Urbaniak, Gil Evans, Archie Shepp, and Lester Bowie. In 2007, her 1970s song "Papaya" gained widespread popularity in Asia and Latin America.
